<domain>
## Phase Boundary

In-app and browser deadline reminders with double-permission opt-in. Reminder fires as Sonner toast when the app is open on the due date. Browser notification fires when Notification API permission granted (in-app only, no background push). Custom modal precedes native permission prompt. New-match alert fires on page load when profile matches exist since last visit. Notification type toggles persist across sessions.
